evidence.observation: 4.1 ppm at start of growth, matching the ramp baseline of about 3-7 ppm
Rose steadily: 6.0, 13.1, 19.6, 26.5 ppm from t=2640 to 3000 s
Flow steady at about 99-100 sccm, matching the setpoint, so the rise is not from lost purge flow
Holding at 750 C with heater at about 46%, so temperature control is normal
Pressure gauge not installed, so the tube atmosphere cannot be checked and a seal leak cannot be told apart from a blocked exhaust

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure reading: normal or low pressure would point to a seal leak, high pressure to a blocked exhaust. A leak check or exhaust inspection would also settle it.
